periods.label: 兄控水术士的登场

appearance.overview: Petite, doll-like girl with silver hair and emerald eyes.

attire.default: Hagun uniform; gothic-lolita outfit for outing

personality.summary: Externally cool and sharp-tongued, internally devoted to Ikki with romantic intensity.
fears: Ikki rejecting her as a woman
desires: become the person who gives Ikki all the love the world denied him
personality.inner_conflict: She knows sibling romance is socially forbidden but refuses to let common ethics overrule her love for Ikki.

decision_pattern.combat: uses precise control and trapping rather than brute force

address_pattern.stella: 史黛菈同学, often with insults

quote_samples: 别人是别人，我们是我们。
我才不会出那种差错呢。

mannerisms: kisses or clings to Ikki to press romantic claims
uses formal logic to justify outrageous affection
habits.daily_routine: Lets Nagi style her hair and coordinate outfits.
quirks: threatens even friends when Ikki is involved
treats humans with generalized distaste except a few trusted people

background.upbringing: Raised in the same family that ostracized Ikki; realized his suffering only after he left home four years earlier.
formative_events: Ikki's disappearance turned her sisterly affection into romantic devotion and hatred of the family that abandoned him
background.pre_story: Entered Hagun as second-ranked freshman and sought reunion with Ikki.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and object of romantic devotion.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Jealous rival but respected after Stella saves hostages.
relationships.nobunobu-suga: First selection battle opponent, defeated by water techniques.

secrets: Openly admits to Nagi that she loves Ikki as a man, not merely as a brother.
periods.summary: Shizuku reunites with Ikki by kissing him in class, triggering conflict with Stella and a classroom-destroying duel. Nagi helps her process her taboo love. During the Rebellion hostage incident she secretly casts a water barrier to protect hostages, enabling Ikki and Stella to counterattack. She wins her first selection match by using ultra-pure water and drowning tactics against an electric opponent.

key_events.summary: Appears after Ikki defeats Manabe's group and kisses him before the class.
Fights Stella and destroys the classroom, earning a week of suspension.
Creates Shouha Suiren to shield all hostages from Rebellion gunfire.
Defeats Nobunobu Suga despite elemental disadvantage.

periods.label: 深海魔女的强敌预告
titles: 破军学园一年一班B级骑士

status.selection_battle_record: continues undefeated; next official opponent is Toka Todo

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki, sharp-tongued toward Stella, and more mature in love than her teasing suggests; in combat she shows cold destructive intensity.
desires: fight opponents strong enough to force full effort

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she supports his happiness even while teasing Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Bickering romantic rival; she nonetheless acknowledges Stella if Stella can make Ikki happy.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend and usual training companion.
relationships.toka-todo: Upcoming opponent and Hagun's strongest student.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Ikki defeat Renren and explains that his struggle against Kirihara was not because the enemy was simply unseen. She spars verbally with Stella over Ikki and gives a surprisingly mature account of wanting Ikki's happiness. In the epilogue she trains alone, freezes roughly fifty students in a free-for-all without moving from the center, and smiles at the news that her next opponent is Hagun's strongest student, Toka Todo.

key_events.summary: Explains why Renren's speed is insufficient against Ikki's sword range.
Freezes a mass challenge and receives Toka Todo as next opponent.

periods.time: Selection battle against Toka and final-day crisis
periods.label: 深海魔女的败北与声援
titles: 破军学园一年级B级伐刀者

status.current: eliminated from Seven Stars selection but becomes one of Ikki's strongest supporters

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and ideal; her desire to stand beside him motivates her training and later her support.
relationships.toka-todo: Opponent who defeats her in a B-rank duel; later asks her to consider stopping Ikki from fighting.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Love rival turned ally; Shizuku attacks Stella when she says she may break up with Ikki, then helps support Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Closest confidant; he holds her while she cries after losing.

periods.summary: The prologue reveals Shizuku's childhood disdain for hypocritical adults and her decisive attachment to Ikki, the only person who corrected her. Her match against Toka tests whether she can stand beside Ikki at the Seven Stars Festival. She uses refined water control, Frozen Plains, White Night Barrier and Scarlet Water Blade, but Toka's martial skill, Reverse Sight and Raikiri overwhelm her; she loses while still clutching Toka's foot, proving she fought to the end. Afterward she breaks down only in Alice's arms. During the scandal she refuses to let Stella call the relationship a mistake, later chooses not to stop Ikki despite Toka's request, and gathers students to cheer him at the gate.

key_events.summary: Recalls why she loves and follows Ikki before facing Toka.
Fights Toka with all her water techniques but loses to Raikiri.
Fires an ice spear at Stella after Stella suggests breaking up with Ikki.
Hears Toka's warning and chooses to bet on Ikki's will.
Catches Ikki at the gate and tells him he is not alone.

periods.time: A day secretly observed by Kagami
periods.label: 珠雫篇秘密跟踪采访
titles: 破军学园一年四班健康股长

status.current: trusted class healer but socially aloof except around Ikki
status.training: learning short-sword techniques from Ikki and sparring with Alice

personality.summary: Usually expressionless and distant, but intensely devoted to her older brother and stubborn in training.

habits.daily_routine: Wakes around 7 a.m., attends class as health representative, eats a Japanese set lunch, checks online posts about Ikki, and trains in the forest with Alice.

preferences.food: usually chooses Japanese set meals; dislikes meat and either orders udon like Ikki or passes meat to Stella

quirks: slow to wake in the morning
posts over one hundred replies in Ikki's fan thread under her own account

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Her beloved older brother and the center of her attention; she studies his fan thread and learns short-sword techniques from him.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Alice protects her from walking into the dorm hallway underdressed and later dominates but supports her in sparring practice.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Lunch companion who receives Shizuku's unwanted meat when Shizuku avoids meat dishes.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Subject of Kagami's secret profile, which exposes Shizuku's routines and brother fixation.

periods.summary: Kagami's Shizuku profile shows Shizuku waking later than Ikki, nearly stepping into the dorm hall in a translucent silk nightgown before Alice pulls her back, serving as a trusted healer for her class, eating mostly Japanese set meals, avoiding meat, obsessively posting in Ikki's fan thread, and continuing short-sword training with Alice despite being repeatedly knocked down.

key_events.summary: Her dorm morning, class healer role, lunch habits, online brother devotion and forest sparring are observed.

periods.label: 深海魔女救回姊姊

status.current: joins the Seven Stars roster after other Hagun representatives withdraw
status.condition: survives a near-fatal bisection by converting her own body into water vapor and reconstituting it

personality.summary: Usually cold and brother-focused, but this volume proves she deeply values Alice as her first important friend outside Ikki.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; he escorts her to Akatsuki and accepts her resolve to save Alice.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Her important friend and sister figure; she refuses to abandon Alice despite the assassin past.
relationships.wallenstein: Defeats him after he nearly kills her, using Water Rebirth and internal drowning/ice attacks.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival for Ikki's closeness; Stella warns Ikki to follow Shizuku during Akatsuki's trap.

periods.summary: Shizuku supports the training camp as a healer and shows unusual insight into Alice's distance from others during their last-night drink. When Alice is captured by Akatsuki, she pursues him with Ikki despite knowing it may be a trap. In Akatsuki's underground training area Wallenstein bisects her, but she activates the risky new Noble Art Water Rebirth, turning her body into vapor and reconstructing herself. From that state she bypasses Wallenstein's friction defense, fills his lungs with water, impales him internally with ice, and rescues Alice. After the assault she accepts a transferred representative slot for Seven Stars.

key_events.summary: She recognizes that Alice is reaching out on a special night.
She defeats Wallenstein and saves Alice.
She accepts a Hagun representative slot after withdrawals.
